Formula s_k = population standard deviation of the local estimates beta_ik over the tracts with a finite fit. Permutation p relabels (X, y) among the tracts with a keyed swap-or-not shuffle, refits every tract at the bandwidth already selected on the observed data, and records s_k^(p). g_k = number of permutations with s_k^(p) >= s_k; pseudo p = (g_k + 1)/(P + 1); z_k = (s_k - mean of s_k^(p))/sd of s_k^(p). Failed permuted fits are left out and counted.

\begin{aligned}
\term{observedStandardDeviation}{s_k}&=\operatorname{sd}_i\,\beta_{ik},
&\term{simulatedMean}{\bar s_k}&=\frac{1}{P}\sum_{p=1}^{P}s_k^{(p)}\\
\term{exceedances}{g_k}&=\#\{p:\ s_k^{(p)}\ge s_k\},
&\term{pseudoPValue}{p_k}&=\frac{g_k+1}{\term{permutationCount}{P}+1}\\
\term{zSimulated}{z_k}&=\frac{s_k-\bar s_k}{\term{simulatedDeviation}{\sigma_{s_k}}}
\end{aligned}

Failed permuted fits are left out and counted.
